claim.adversary: ROBUST within the admitted caller-run projection publication and tested native profile
claim.scope: OfflineCatalog binds exact simple projection names, keys, row counts and ordered prepared schemas to the target DDL. Both transform output owners pass caller-precomputed Wide and Compact children to the existing atomic part writers.
claim.remaining: Caller supplies rows ordered by each part key. Additional projection declarations, keys, partitions, layout and type products, and automatic computation and maintenance require separate qualification.

risk.strongest_failure: Publish a child against the wrong target declaration or leave a partial parent when a child fails staged readback.
checks: Match projections by exact names even when callback order differs from DDL order. Reject missing, extra, duplicate, wrong-name, wrong-key, wrong-order, wrong-type and wrong-count children after full callback scan.
Refuse aggregate projection DDL before callback and refuse post-scan metadata identity drift. Neither leaves files in detached.
Each standalone child and parent control fits the readback budget. A larger mixed roster exceeds the shared limit during child readback and removes the staging directory.
Test both mixed layouts against pinned ClickHouse with real source data and persisted DDL. Independently compare literal RowBinary, physical marks, native part identities and original file digests.
risk.rollback: Revert the feature commit. The writer publishes only after staged validation and deletes the stage on failure.

verification.baseline_debug: The projection-free transform publishes a detached part. The valid simple projection case stops before the callback with transform target cannot declare projections.

native.layouts: Plain Compact MRK4 and adaptive Wide MRK2 with UInt64 and String. Parents and the Wide child use String with_size_stream. The Compact child uses String single_stream.
native.observations: Both generated pairs pass ATTACH PART and CHECK TABLE. Direct parent, direct projection and forced projection reads match literal RowBinary. EXPLAIN selects by_score. ClickHouse preserves all original file hashes. OfflineCatalog reopens a byte-identical copy of each native attached part and reads exact full rows and windows with parent batch identity.
native.release_replay: The first Release run stopped on a run_safe setpgid diagnostic. The complete Release rerun in a fresh scratch directory passed with the same source, helper, guard, and runtime hashes.

refresh_when: Rerun guarded specs and both native helper modes after changes to transform binding, projection writer/readback, codec and transport budgets, metadata grammar, the admitted layout or types, toolchain, or ClickHouse. Rebuild helpers from the recorded source and argv.
